charge.title: What the course asks for
charge.description: Each kind of work in the course with its rubric, method and guide: what each work inherits when it is created.

calendar.title: Due dates
calendar.description: Each assignment with its kind and its date. You build it yourself, with the course syllabus at hand.

works.title: Works
works.description: Each work with its progress, its sources and its submission. You mark it «Submitted» yourself: it does not depend on progress.

feedback.title: Feedback and learning
feedback.description: What the professor corrects and how it changes the next work. A correction that repeats gets a decision: it goes to your guide or it is dismissed.

toast.saveFailed: Changes could not be saved. Please try again.
toast.modeFree: Done: you work week by week, without a calendar.
toast.modeCalendar: Done: you work with due dates.

charge.typesLabel: Kinds of work in the course
charge.empty: There are no kinds of work yet. Each one (a weekly paper, an essay, the final paper) has its rubric, its method and its guide.
charge.edit: Edit what the course asks for
charge.dialogHint: The course data and its kinds of work. Each block saves with its own button.
charge.noRepeat: «Do not repeat sources» is on: each work is compared with the previous one of the same kind.

mode.calendarHint: Each assignment with its kind and its date.
mode.free: Week by week, without a calendar
mode.freeHint: Each work you create here becomes an assignment, without a date.

calendar.empty: There are no assignments yet. Add the first one with its kind and its date.
calendar.emptyFree: No calendar: each work you create from the table appears here as an assignment, without a date.
calendar.formHint: The kind of work decides the rubric, method and guide the work is created with.
calendar.label: Label
calendar.labelHint: What the course calls it: «Paper #9», «Essay», «Final paper».
calendar.labelSuggested: Suggested: «{{label}}», the next number. You can change it.
calendar.passageHint: In your Bible's numbering. If it is from the course's book, the range is enough.
calendar.passageInvalid: The passage is not recognized. Write it as «4:13-5:6» or «Jas 4:13-5:6».
calendar.dueDateHint: Without a date, the assignment has no deadline.
calendar.noWorkTypes: First define the kinds of work in «What the course asks for».
calendar.removeHint: The work, if it exists, is not deleted: it just stops being an assignment.
calendar.removeWithRecord: This assignment has its submission or the professor's feedback recorded, and they are lost with it. The work is not deleted.
calendar.paperHint: The course's works that are not an assignment yet.

works.noWorkTypes: Define the kinds of work in «What the course asks for» to build the table.
works.empty: There are no assignments yet. Add them in the calendar or bring in your previous works.
works.unknownType: Kind of work that no longer exists
works.offCalendar_one: 1 course work is not an assignment:
works.importHint: Do you have previous works on their own or in another project? Bring them into the course with their kind, without changing their rules.

feedbackDialog.title: Feedback on {{label}}
feedbackDialog.hint: Paste or type what the professor returned and classify each correction. Recording it does not mark the work as submitted.
feedbackDialog.textPlaceholder: Paste the feedback here as it arrived.
feedbackDialog.correctionsHint: Each correction with its pattern: one you already have or a new one with the name you give it («double closing», «category ≠ translation»).
feedbackDialog.patternName: Name of the new pattern of correction {{n}}
feedbackDialog.notePlaceholder: Detail (optional): «v. 14, double closing in the conclusion»
feedbackDialog.incomplete: A correction is missing its pattern name.

feedback.empty: When you submit a work, record here what the professor returned. The corrections that repeat make up your record.
feedback.reopenGuideHint: Deciding again does not remove the rule from the guide: do that in its editor.

guideRule.title: Add «{{name}}» to your guide
guideRule.hint: The rule goes into the guide read by the analysis and the prose review of the next work. Write it in your own words.
guideRule.ruleTextHint: It starts with the name you gave the correction. Write it the way you want to read it in your guide.
guideRule.noGuide: This course has no style guide. Choose one in «Edit what the course asks for» and come back here.
guideRule.already: Your guide already had that rule: the decision was recorded.

errors.pattern-not-found: That correction no longer exists in the course.
errors.guide-without-manifest: The guide's rules have not been read yet: open it in its editor before adding a rule.
errors.guide-full: The guide already has the maximum number of rules.

import.title: Bring in previous works
import.hint: Each work is linked to the course with its kind and appears in the calendar. The course rules are not applied again: a submitted work does not change its assignment.
import.empty: There is nothing to bring in: all your studies are already in the calendar.
import.thisCourse: from this course, not an assignment
import.willLink: It belongs to another project: it is linked to this course without leaving that one.
import.tooMany: You can bring in up to {{max}} works at a time.
import.done_one: 1 work is now in the calendar.
import.done_other: {{count}} works are now in the calendar.
import.failed: The works could not be brought in. Please try again.
import.warnLinked: «{{title}}» still belongs to its original project; here it appears linked.
import.warnNotFound: «{{title}}» was not found and was not brought in.

sources.coverageTitle: What the kinds of work ask for

create.fulfills: This work fulfills «{{label}}» in the course calendar.
create.newEntry: This work goes into the course calendar as «{{label}}», without a date.
create.linkFailed: The work was created, but it could not be linked to «{{label}}». Link it by editing that assignment in the course calendar.
create.newEntryUnlabeled: This work goes into the course calendar as an assignment, without a date.
